name: wxo-talk-with-your-data
displayName: Talk with your data on watsonx Orchestrate
description: Turn an Excel or CSV file into a text-to-SQL agent on watsonx Orchestrate and show it on a demo page with the embedded chat. SQLite bundled inside the Python tool, no external database for the prototype. Database sources and an Orchestrate refresh flow come in 1.2.

safety.warning: Importing a tool or an agent replaces objects with the same name in your Orchestrate tenant, and the chart tool uploads chart images built from your data.
safety.covered: The skill and the pack rule name the environment and the objects and ask before each import; charts go to your own COS bucket by default with no silent fallback, and the free public hosting option is described as demo-only, for made-up data.

watsonx-orchestrate-adk-docs.reason: Documentation search: the server exposes two read-only tools over https and needs no credentials.
